resources.string:
GymTracker writes your finished workouts to Health Connect so they appear alongside the rest of your health data.

It writes only: the start and end time of each workout, its name, and — when a workout was run on a watch with heart-rate permission — the heart-rate readings recorded during it.

It never reads anything from Health Connect, and what it writes there stays on this device.

Separately, if you sign in, your workouts are synced to your account; heart rate is included only if you turn that on yourself on the Account screen. Nothing is sold or shared with advertisers.

You can turn Health Connect writing off at any time on the Account screen, and revoke the permission in Health Connect itself.
No app available to open the privacy policy. It is published at https://gym-tracker-44a5f.web.app/privacy.html
